_comment: The item TYPE contract for the whole game. Each type's `tag` is the PixelLab tag the maintainer puts on an object in the create-object UI — that tag is the ground truth for what an item IS, and pipeline/sync.py discovers items by exactly these tags. Adding a type here (with its tag) is all it takes for a newly tagged batch to start syncing. `rarities` is the shared rarity ladder every item's `rarity` field is drawn from. A type may declare `shared_name`: every item of that type carries that ONE display name (SOUL -> every stone is a "Soulstone"; they differ by their description, element and power, not by name), and sync enforces it instead of the usual unique-name rule. NOTHING here is generated: edit by hand.

MISC.label: Junk
MISC.summary: Loot dropped by monsters with no use but gold — body parts, hides, feathers, minerals, oddments. Sold at any shop.

SOUL.label: Soul Stone
SOUL.summary: A soul stone dropped by monsters. Merged into a weapon or a piece of armor to grant it the stone's power; the stone is consumed by the merge.

CONSUMABLE.label: Consumable
CONSUMABLE.summary: Used from the bag for an immediate effect — potions, elixirs, food. Consumed on use.

SWORD.label: Sword
SWORD.summary: Melee weapon. Equipped in the weapon slot; can carry merged soul powers.

BOW.label: Bow
BOW.summary: Ranged weapon. Equipped in the weapon slot; can carry merged soul powers.

WAND.label: Wand
WAND.summary: Magic weapon. Equipped in the weapon slot; can carry merged soul powers.

ARMOR.label: Armor
ARMOR.summary: Worn protection. Equipped in the armor slot; can carry merged soul powers.
